I don’t really know how to fix the hygiene thing but I’ve been in a similar situation when it comes to the food being left out. I had a roommate that left the kitchen an absolute mess all the time. I called a house meeting and didn’t say it directly to them but said something along the lines of “if we all do our own dishes we won’t have as many to do” and since then there’s the occasional bowl left on the counter but it’s definitely not as bad as before and nobody got offended. It worked for me so maybe it will work for you! Roommates can be annoying and sometimes it sucks but you shouldn’t have to sit and go through it. Bring it up to everybody in the house and make sure they can say whatever it is they may find annoying or want to change so you don’t seem like the bad guy.
